display_long_description:
Play mini-golf from a hamster’s perspective! 🐹 Swing through a giant living room where chairs are mountains and cables are hazards. Realistic physics meets a "shrunk-down" world in this immersive 10-hole VR adventure!
[media]
⛳10 Creative, Hand-Crafted Holes: From navigating around a high-end PC setup to banking shots off the kitchen island, every hole offers a unique challenge.
[media]
🏌️Natural physics and swing mechanics make it feel like you’re holding a real putter.
[media]
